sources.title: Pokémon TCG Rules — Sword & Shield—Fusion Strike
sources.verification: The V-UNION appendix distinguishes card characteristics in private zones and states that Pokémon V-UNION are considered Pokémon V only while in play.

sources.title: Play! Pokémon Competitive Pokémon Rules and Formats
sources.verification: The official index provides maintained entry points for rulebooks, legality notices and errata.
sources.supportsZh: 用于后续逐卡、逐格式核验；索引页不被当作任何单卡的完整裁定。

retrievalLimitations: No PTCG Live behavior, Chinese translation, image, filename or community source is used as rules authority.
No Pokémon family, including V, ex, Radiant or V-UNION, is inferred from another marker.
implementationLimits: Supports explicit audited Pokémon-family metadata only in reviewed private-zone card-selection filters.
Supported filter expressions are ANY, ALL and NONE over a non-empty pokemon_families set and require card_category POKEMON.
The engine does not make a real card playable until its full text, timing, format legality and family metadata are audited.
